title: Brave doesn't mean unafraid. It means not alone.
note: 9 slides; slide 1 redrawn once for garbled background sign lettering
caption:
Which one did you need today? Tell us its number.

Today is about gratitude. Thankfulness for the strength, the peace and the presence that keep showing up for us, even on ordinary days.

Joshua 1:9, Proverbs 3:5, Philippians 4:13, Isaiah 40:29, Isaiah 41:13, John 3:16, Exodus 33:14, John 14:27 (BSB)

Save this for the day you need it.

slides.text: Brave doesn't mean unafraid. It means not alone.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding
I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.
You are not behind. You are held.
For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son
My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.
Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you.
